Diagnostic accuracy of a universal screening multiple gating procedure: A replication study.
Stephen P. Kilgus, Nathaniel P. von der Embse, Crystal N. Taylor, Michael P. Van Wie, Wesley A. Sims

The purpose of this diagnostic accuracy study was to evaluate the sensitivity and specificity (among other indicators) of three universal screening approaches, including the Social, Academic, and Emotional Behavior Risk Screener (SAEBRS), a SAEBRS-based teacher nomination tool, and a multiple gating procedure (MGP).
